algorithm: Gaussian copula with declared shared normal factors and inverse CDF mappings

dimension_consumers.time_orientation: program start quantile;EV ready-early versus defer preference
dimension_consumers.manual_burden: same tradeoff and shift fraction;dryer waiting sensitivity
dimension_consumers.thermal_level: cooling preference only;not tied to early/late time preference
dimension_consumers.autonomy: experimental confirmation preference within original permission

class_cores.A: 关注节省，重视解释和可靠性，调整先确认
class_cores.B: 舒适和生活便利优先，不因小额节省接受明显打扰
class_cores.C: 自主决定、当天确认、可以撤回
class_cores.D: 积极响应，明确边界内支持自动优化
class_cores.E: 照护、舒适和生活稳定优先，默认建议与确认
class_cores.F: 出行和目标电量优先，支持边界内充电优化

Gaussian_copula_transform.use: correlated latent uniforms;not empirical household fitting

class_cores.use: fixed household core;members never redraw A-F

cooling_support_C.use: experimental support for a cooling preference;not a heating/actuator permission

latent_marginals.use: relative preference coordinates,not acceptance probabilities or population frequencies

loading_default.use: shared latent loading;pairwise latent correlation is loading squared;0.7 remains a pilot starting point

time_domain.source: original machine windows,release/deadline,program duration,operator rights and calendars
time_domain.use: uniform quantile on sorted feasible clock grid;not exact conditioning of an unconstrained copula

temperature_step_C.use: discrete-uniform cooling preference grid inside EB support

authorization_confirmation_threshold.use: D/F may prefer confirmation above this autonomy coordinate;never grants absent standing permission

member_context_mapping.use: early/late via0.5,tradeoff via routine-versus-burden ranking;affected members retain separate opinions and may narrow standing consent;not independent schedules or psychological measurements

willingness_mapping.use: fraction of existing reschedule bound one prefers to discuss,not hard feasibility or consent

thermal_mapping.use: soft desired maximum change;no heating,off or preconditioning permission

device_mechanism_preferences.use: dryer waiting sensitivity=manual_burden;hot-water readiness=comfort_sensitivity;EV readiness=1-time_orientation;all evaluation context only
